title.sw: IG Metall yaongeza migomo ya onyo

summary.en: Warning strikes in the metal and electrical industry grow on Monday. About 3.7 million workers are in the pay talks. The union wants 5% more, the employers offered less.
summary.sw: Migomo ya onyo katika sekta ya chuma na umeme yaongezeka Jumatatu. Wafanyakazi takriban milioni 3.7 wako katika mazungumzo ya mishahara. Chama kinataka nyongeza ya 5%, waajiri wametoa kidogo zaidi.

title.sw: Berlin: mazungumzo ya muungano yaanza leo

summary.en: The Left, the Greens and the SPD start talks on a new Berlin government on Monday morning. A deal could be ready by December, but that is not sure.
summary.sw: Chama cha Linke, Greens na SPD zinaanza mazungumzo ya serikali mpya ya Berlin Jumatatu asubuhi. Makubaliano yanaweza kuwa tayari ifikapo Desemba, lakini hilo si hakika.

title.sw: Kigoma: mvua ya mawe yaharibu nyumba 70

summary.en: Strong wind and hail blew roofs off more than 70 houses and two churches in Kigoma-Ujiji. Two people were hurt and some families have no shelter.
summary.sw: Upepo mkali na mvua ya mawe viliezua mapaa ya nyumba zaidi ya 70 na makanisa mawili Kigoma-Ujiji. Watu wawili walijeruhiwa na baadhi ya familia hazina makazi.

title.en: CAF happy with Dar stadium work
title.sw: CAF yaridhika na kazi ya uwanja Dar

summary.en: After a visit on 31 October, CAF said it is encouraged by the work at Benjamin Mkapa Stadium and training grounds. Tanzania, Kenya and Uganda host AFCON from 19 June 2027.
summary.sw: Baada ya ziara ya tarehe 31 Oktoba, CAF ilisema imetiwa moyo na kazi katika Uwanja wa Benjamin Mkapa na viwanja vya mazoezi. Tanzania, Kenya na Uganda zitaandaa AFCON kuanzia tarehe 19 Juni 2027.

title.sw: Arusha yaandaa wanasayansi 300 wa hali ya hewa

summary.en: From 2 to 6 November, more than 300 scientists from 75 countries meet in Arusha for an IPCC working group. They prepare the next big climate report.
summary.sw: Kuanzia tarehe 2 hadi 6 Novemba, wanasayansi zaidi ya 300 kutoka nchi 75 wanakutana Arusha kwa kikundi cha kazi cha IPCC. Wanaandaa ripoti kubwa ijayo ya hali ya hewa.

lesson.de: Wo ist die Konferenz? Die Konferenz ist in Arusha.
lesson.en: Where is the conference? The conference is in Arusha.
lesson.sw: Mkutano uko wapi? Mkutano uko Arusha.

question.sw: Swali lipi la Kijerumani ni sahihi?

options.en: Wo ist die Konferenz? (Where is the conference?)
options.sw: Wo ist die Konferenz? (Mkutano uko wapi?)

explanation.en: B: Wo ist die Konferenz? In a W-question the question word is in position 1 and the verb is in position 2, the same verb rule as in Heute regnet es viel. Wo = where. The other two put the verb at the end or the question word in the wrong place. Five words: wo = where; die Konferenz = conference; beginnen = to begin; die Woche = week; bis = until. Example: Die Konferenz beginnt heute. Review: der Regen, regnen, viel. Emin: Mkutano unaanza leo. = The meeting starts today. This practice does not prove exam readiness.
explanation.sw: B: Wo ist die Konferenz? Katika swali la W neno la swali liko mahali pa kwanza na kitenzi mahali pa pili, kanuni ileile ya kitenzi kama katika Heute regnet es viel. Wo = wapi. Nyingine mbili zinaweka kitenzi mwishoni au neno la swali mahali pasipofaa. Maneno matano: wo = wapi; die Konferenz = mkutano; beginnen = kuanza; die Woche = wiki; bis = hadi. Mfano: Die Konferenz beginnt heute. Marudio: der Regen, regnen, viel. Emin: Mkutano unaanza leo. = The meeting starts today. Mazoezi haya hayathibitishi utayari wa mtihani.
